name: bekaert-playwright-bdd-ai-framework
description: Enterprise-level Playwright BDD AI-ready automation framework

scripts.test: npm run bdd:gen && npx playwright test
scripts.test:headed: npm run bdd:gen && npx playwright test --headed
scripts.test:smoke: npm run bdd:gen && npx playwright test --grep @smoke --grep-invert @blocked
scripts.test:regression: npm run bdd:gen && npx playwright test --grep @regression --grep-invert @blocked
scripts.test:ecommerce: npm run bdd:gen && npx playwright test --grep @ecommerce --grep-invert @blocked
scripts.test:blocked: npm run bdd:gen && npx playwright test --grep @blocked
scripts.test:debug: npm run bdd:gen && npx playwright test --debug
